title: 1988 Score Dave Righetti New York Yankees #351 - Set Of 6
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a set of 6 original 1988 Score Dave Righetti New York Yankees #351 trading cards. These vintage baseball cards feature the player Dave Righetti from the New York Yankees team. Each card measures 3½" x 2½" and is a part of the Score set. These autographed cards are a must-have for fans and collectors of baseball memorabilia, especially those interested in the history of the New York Yankees franchise.
